Subject: Marketplace RFI - tenant isolation, BOM, and billing mapping

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our marketplace qualification (AWS/Azure/GCP) we need a short technical annex that covers: tenant isolation model, data flow (including encryption at rest/in transit), a bill of materials for listing (per-region AMI/container size/SKU mappings), and a billing mapping table so our procurement team can reconcile charges in our cloud marketplace invoices.

Could you send a completed annex and a BOM CSV by EOD Tuesday? Also let me know if Redwood requires any special licensing clauses for marketplace listing or metered billing. We may need your legal and finance to sign off on the language.

Appreciate it — Jill

Subject: Re: Marketplace RFI - tenant isolation, BOM, and billing mapping

Hi Jill —

Thanks for the clear list. Please find attached two artifacts that should cover what you requested:
- Redwood_RFI_Technical_Annex_2026-06-21.pdf (attachment) — includes tenant isolation options, data flows, encryption, KMS/HSM options, and certs.
- Redwood_BOM_2026-06-21.csv (attachment) — per-region container SKUs, recommended instance sizes, and suggested AMI/container images for AWS/Azure/GCP.
- Redwood_Marketplace_Billing_Mapping.xlsx (attachment) — maps Redwood usage metrics to common marketplace meter IDs and example invoice line items.

High-level answers inline below:

1) Tenant isolation model
- Default: logical multi-tenant with strong namespace isolation, per-customer encryption keys (recommended).
- Optional: single-tenant/private deployment (Redwood Private) with VPC/VPN or on-prem agents for customers requiring physical isolation.
- We support dedicated GPU pools (Redwood Dedicated) for committed capacity; those are separate from shared clusters and have network & KMS isolation.

2) Encryption and data handling
- All ingress traffic TLS 1.2+/MTLS where supported; at-rest encryption with customer-managed keys (BYOK) via KMS/HSM integrations.
- KV cache and ephemeral request logs are encrypted; persistent audit logs are retained per contract and can be routed to customer S3/GCS/Azure Blob.

3) BOM and per-region SKUs
- See attached CSV for recommended instance shapes and container sizes. We include a fallback quantized model image for constrained GPU SKUs.

4) Marketplace billing mapping
- The attached workbook maps our per-token/embedding unit model to marketplace meter IDs. We can collaborate with your billing team to align metering windows.

Legal/licensing note
- We use a usage-based model for hosted API and a subscription/commit model for Dedicated. We typically accept standard marketplace licensing clauses with a short addendum for data handling; our legal team is available for quick redlines.

Next steps
- I can run a 30-minute walkthrough of the annex and BOM with your engineering/procurement folks tomorrow. Let me know a time window.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Jill's request and the annex/BOM I drafted (attachments). Quick asks before I send a final packet:

- Karthik: can you confirm the instance sizing guidance in row 12–18 of the BOM? There's an alternative recommendation for GCP n2 vs. a2 accelerators I want to flag.
- Marissa: finance needs to sign off on the billing mapping — can you confirm the meter mapping and whether we should propose monthly vs. usage invoices for marketplace procurement?
- Vivek: any security caveats we should call out re: shared KV cache and audit log retention (SOC2 evidence) beyond what's in the annex? I want to avoid surprises during their security questionnaire.

Inline comments added to the annex PDF where I need your brief clarification. Aim to close this morning so I can send Jill the final workbook and propose a demo slot this afternoon.

Kim

- Redwood_BOM_2026-06-24.csv (final)
- Redwood_Marketplace_Billing_Mapping.xlsx (final)

Summary of changes since the draft:
- Clarified tenant isolation options and added the recommended default for Acme (logical multi-tenant with per-customer KMIP/BYOK).
- Updated GCP accelerator guidance to prefer A2 for inference workloads at scale (karthik confirmed) and added fallback quantized images for cost-sensitive SKUs.
- Finance confirmed marketplace meter mapping; recommended monthly billing with usage reconciliation to simplify Acme's internal chargeback process.
- Security clarified audit log retention and SOC 2 references; we included a pointer to the SOC 2 report (redwood-soc2-2025.pdf) in the annex.

Next steps:
- If this looks good, shall we schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough and a separate procurement sync? I'm available tomorrow 10–12 PT or Friday afternoon.
- I can also share a short DocuSign for the standard marketplace addendum if legal wants to redline.

Thanks for the fast turnaround on your side. Happy to iterate if procurement or engineering needs more detail.

Best,
